events.title: Silk Collector Is Officially Announced
events.summary: Hello Collectors,Silk Collector is now officially announced, and its Steam page is live. You may know us from Tailor Simulator, and since this is our second game, I am really excited to be writing this announcement. First, let me tell you a little about Silk Collector.Core GameplayEvery piece on the floor already has a place somewhere across three floors.
